title: Ham and Algerian Tagine Tacos
description: A twist on traditional tacos, this dish combines the flavors of Mexico and Algeria with the savory taste of ham.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add diced onion and sauté until translucent.
Add diced green chilies and cook for 2 minutes.
Add diced ham and cook until heated through.
Stir in Algerian Tagine spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble tacos by spooning ham mixture onto tortillas and topping with chopped cilantro, a dollop of Mexican crema, and a squeeze of lime juice.
